scope: Local Windows worktree; repair of the confirmed software defects recorded in the 2026-10-05 audit, with documentation reconciliation

provenance.recorded_run: Every value under `gaps_repaired`, `checks` and `performance_comparison` is transcribed from the repair report named in `source_document`; it is the machine-readable form of that run, not a re-measurement.
provenance.independent_revalidation: The `independent_revalidation` block is a separate execution performed later on 2026-10-05 at the same HEAD and the same uncommitted worktree. Only the three automated gates listed there were re-run.

gaps_repaired.summary: Parameterized /mode, /permission mode, /provider and /review dispatch explicitly; other terminal commands are marked terminal-reference, raise on send and preserve the draft instead of reaching the model
Pin changes persist immediately; forks and automatic rotation copy an independent pin list while an ordinary new session clears it
CLI and Desktop restore pins on launch, load and switch
Write coordination over a real Git checkout and non-Git overlapping directories; root, subdirectory and path aliases cannot bypass the lock, independently managed worktrees keep parallelism

The owning executor loads the saved goal when it acquires the run, passes it into this turn's system message and run record; queued tasks read the latest saved value, ordinary goals stay out of read-only review, transient guidance does not sink into compacted history
Chat / Responses / Messages text probes require non-empty valid text; HTTP 200 with empty choices or usage-only cannot report online

The full pinned SKILL.md main body is read each turn and attached to the system request with name, SHA256, character count and completeness; invalidation, an empty body or exceeding 128000 characters blocks execution

Streaming text and Git diff with 2000 lines / 2 MiB per page, 256 KiB per line, 10000 hunk metadata entries, 20 MiB media preview; workspace revision is computed from path/object and streamed content hashes

A workspace SQLite derived index with incremental update replaces reading every session JSON; batched transactions and a compact trigram index cut build cost, literal recheck avoids candidate mismatches, legacy caches rebuild by version

Logs keep 8 MiB current plus 8 MiB previous with up to 1 MiB restore and UTF-8 / JSONL boundary handling; the PTY disk queue applies backpressure and marks burst loss; asynchronous Workbench, goal and isolated-directory responses verify project/session ownership and wait for the previous poll

A valid empty array is distinguished from a malformed payload; findings require valid fields, a priority and a real file/line inside the captured diff; the raw output is saved rather than read as no-problems. Read-only review no longer inherits the coding completion continuation rule

Command palette gains arrow keys, Enter, selected-item scrolling and ARIA, and does not select during composition; the goal bar clears a stale goal on session switch and hides 0/0 verification when there are no steps
Builds emit a distinguishable identifier; the About page shows build ID, build time and the actual GUI/kernel launch path

The built-in Engine gains a Pyglet native window, event loop and ModernGL presentation wired to current-frame input, actual window size, close and exception-time resource release; initialization failure is reported explicitly and the headless path stays available
Guides, status matrix, roadmap, documentation index and changelog reconciled
Two outdated regression fixture / query assumptions corrected while keeping the original semantic assertions

repair_boundary: Loading the full Skill main body each turn guarantees the host supplied the instructions; it does not guarantee the model follows every step semantically and does not auto-execute references or scripts.

actual_network_requests.boundary: The server returns protocol fixtures only and does not demonstrate remote model quality

standalone_cli.runtime: Real Windows PTY launching the compiled reverie.exe

real_pty_logs.after_gui_restart: both terminal records restored as exited / 0

performance_comparison.boundary: Observed range, not a latency guarantee for all machines and repositories

search manager reusing the index after restart

performance_comparison.first_index_build_boundary: Single construction sample that still reads 1000 bodies; not a repeated cold-disk range. Exact hashes and total line counts still scan the full stream per page; random disk paging and cancellation are not closed. Short queries, SQLite without trigram and file-timestamp reconciliation retain scan cost. Paged body hashes match the previous path.

independent_revalidation.head: 127c39769217d87dd7647a3c6b296e2629d8f9ff
independent_revalidation.purpose: Confirm the three automated gates still reproduce at the recorded HEAD and worktree state
independent_revalidation.agreement_with_recorded_run: Pass/skip counts and i18n totals match the recorded run; durations differ because the host load differs.

coverage_boundary.platform: Windows. Eleven `skipif` gates require Windows and three more tests branch on the platform inside the test body, so 1761 passed / 1 skipped is a Windows figure and a non-Windows host reports a higher skip count. See G29.
coverage_boundary.optional_extras: The host did not have the `treesitter` extra installed, so `tree_sitter` was absent and the Context Engine's JavaScript, TypeScript, C, C++, C#, Rust, Go, Java, HTML and CSS parsing exercised only the regex fallback. No test references tree-sitter in either mode. See G30.

not_re_run: Isolated GUI chain, GUI restart and repack checks
Outbound request capture and standalone CLI PTY session
Real PTY log rotation and restore
independent_revalidation.default_vitest_configuration_note: The revalidation used the default `npm test` rather than the recorded run's serial worker and 15 s per-test timeout; the resulting pass/skip counts are identical.

documentation.boundary: Offline relative file/heading check; local ignored evidence is reported separately; external URLs and natural-language claims are not validated

local_material_boundary: Ignored logs, screenshots, packaged artifacts and fixtures are supplementary; this published summary contains the results without requiring those files

remaining_boundaries.G12: Per-source / per-model SSE, tools, thinking signatures, vision and both Claude Desktop modes were not re-accepted; the 2026-10-04 JDW remote anomaly stands only as a dated historical sample
remaining_boundaries.native_ime: Native Chinese IME candidate windows and screen readers still lack host acceptance
remaining_boundaries.portable_first_launch: The portable build's first launch was blocked by automatic approval review, which returned only `blocked by policy`; the action was not retried through another mechanism, so first extraction / launch remains unverified. The compiled GUI, which avoids NSIS extraction cleanup, was used for the runtime checks instead.
